requirement.value: Rogue mastery (the Pilot route is cut) + Cheap Shot or the Personal Vehicle pool pick

system.description: Choose a status at acquisition (dazed/shaken/slow/weak). After an ally's damage costs enemies HP and at least one was Vulnerable to it, one of them loses (half your level + twice your best of Cheap Shot / Personal Vehicle) HP and suffers the status. Once per round, party-wide.
